t: {FONT_SMALL}{COLOR RED}{SHADOW LIGHT_RED}Ultra Emerald IV.5{FONT_NORMAL} Do not share

Heh heh heh! Let's rock! Raise the
roof! Yo yo yo! Rock! Rock! Rock!\lEverybody now!\p…Looks like you don't get rock at
all… I'm a traveling DVD merchant.\pI'm passing through Solaceon Town
on business. Want to buy some\ldiscs?\pTotally rocking tunes!
was:
嘿嘿嘿!Rock 起来!嗥翻天!哟哟哟!
Rock! Rock ! Rock! 大家一起来!\p...看来你一点都不明白摇滚呢...
我是自由售卖DVD的商人,\p刚好经过随意镇行商,
那么你要买一些卡碟吗?\p非常摇滚的曲风哦!
欢迎光临! 来点糕点吗?

t: Hey… hey… you over there, friend.\nI've got rare Balls collected from\lall over the world.\pWant to take a look? Meeting like\nthis must be fate. I travel the\lworld all the time.
was:
嘿...嘿...那边那位小伙伴,
我手上有一些从世界各地\p收集的珍贵球哦,
过来看看吗,\p能遇见也是缘分,
我经常在世界各地旅行

t: We meet again at last, {0xFD 0x01}…!\nI'm so glad to see you once more.\pBut… this is also the last time.\nTake a look at all the rare Poké\lBalls I have{0xF9 0xD3}!
was: 终于再见到你了 {FD01}...!\n非常高兴能再一次见到你,\p但是...这也是最后一次了,\n看看我手上的各种稀有精灵球吧{F9D3}!

t: We meet again at last, {0xFD 0x01}…!\nI'm so glad to see you once more.\pBut… this is also the last time.\nTake a look at all the rare Poké\lBalls I have{0xF9 0xD3}!
was: 终于再见到你了 {FD01}...!\n非常高兴能再一次见到你,\p但是...这也是最后一次了,\n看看我手上的各种稀有精灵球吧{F9D3}!

t: I'm so moved! To mark the\noccasion, let me give you\lsomething that shows off your\lachievement!
was: 我好感动！作为见证\n我给你一件展示出\p你的成绩的物品吧！

t: Please choose the first Fossil to\nhand over.
was: 请选择需交递的第一枚化石。

t: Grandma always said: making\nsomething out of nothing was\lbanned back on March 1, 2006.\lThere's no {0xFD 0x02} in your Bag.
was: 奶奶说过——\n无中生有早在2006年3月1日就被禁止了。\l你的背包里根本就没有{FD02}。

t: The next tournament is being\nprepared. Would you like to enter?
was: 当前赛事绝赞准备中，需要报名参赛吗？

t: Elder Koga: Ready to begin round\n{0xFD 0x02}? (If not, press B to go\lback.)
was: 甲贺长老:准备好开始第{FD02}回战了吗?\n(如果没有准备好请按B键返回.)

t: Ginkgo Guild Member: Sigh… With\nVolo gone and Hisui struck by such\ldisasters, our supplies have\lalmost dried up…\pStill, friend, come and see what\nyou'd like.
was: 银杏商会成员：唉……望罗不在，\n洗翠大地又发生这样的灾难，\l我们的货源几乎都要中断了……\p这位朋友，来看看要点啥吧。

t:
Ginkgo Guild Member: The land of
Hisui is slowly recovering, so we\lcan gather people and trade with\lother regions.\pThis time, our goal is to import
some other kinds of Poké Balls!\pFriend, come and see what you'd
like.
was: 银杏商会成员：洗翠大地正在逐步好转，\p我们也可以召集人手\n去别的地区发展商贸了。\p这次的目标是进口一些\n其他种类的精灵球！\p这位朋友，来看看要点啥吧。

t: What would you like to trade for?
{0xFC 0x01 0x05}Now then, take a look at what's on\noffer.
Exbo, Sunbo, Sudobo… and Aibo,\nPolibo, Togebo!\pI lost! Darn it.
was: 爆太郎、向日太郎、胡太郎、\n还有尾太郎、蛙太郎、波克太郎!\p我输了!可恶。

t: Y-you're this strong?! Why… when I\neven used Z-Power!
was: 你,你竟然怎么强.\n为什么,我明明已经使用了z的力量.

t: Green: Your team is quite dazzling\ntoo…\pI lost!
was: 小蓝:你的阵容也很华丽呢...\p是我输了! \n

t: Silver: I've already become so\nstrong…! How could I lose…!
was: 银:我明明已经很强大了...!\n怎么会输...!

t: I lost. As a Trainer, I admit it:\nyour strength is the ultimate!
was: 是我输了,作为训练师,\n你承认你的强大是究极的!

t: Xiao Bing is so happy to have met\nan opponent like you!
was: 能遇到你这样的对手,\n小冰很高兴呢

t: Hoenn is facing a crisis. As the\nLorekeeper, I've decided to fight\lalongside you!
was: 丰缘面临危机,\n作为传承者我决定与你一同战斗!

t: Hoenn will face a crisis once\nagain, and only I, the Draconid\lLorekeeper, can save it!
was: 丰缘将再次面临危机,\n只有我-流星的传承者才能挽救!

t: Oh, not bad, not bad. You have\nsome skill. But you still have a\llong way to go.
was: 嗬,不错不错,有点实力,\n不过就这样还差得远呢.

t: I'd heard the rumors: your\nstrength surpasses even a\lChampion's!
was: 早有耳闻,你的实力凌驾于冠军!

t: You must have been through\ntraining even harsher than mine to\lbe this strong!
was: 看来你经历过了比我还严酷的训练,\n才能有如此的强大!

t: So this is the best of the Hoenn\nregion…\pYour skill is truly flawless.
was: 丰缘地区的强者吗...\p实力真是无可挑剔了

t: So this is the best of the Hoenn\nregion…\pYour skill is truly flawless.
was: 丰缘地区的强者吗...\p实力真是无可挑剔了

t: Hilda: Sorry, sorry{0xF9 0xD3}! I got carried\naway… I'm sorry…!
was: 透子：抱歉抱歉{F9D3}！\n是我太激动了...对不起... ...！

t:
Serena: I'm Serena, a Trainer from
Vaniville Town in Kalos.\pMy dream is to become Kalos Queen,
and right now I'm traveling around\lHoenn…\pThere seems to be a beautiful
Pokémon behind this door. If you\lwant it, you'll have to beat me\lfirst!
was:
躇雷娜 :我是来自卡洛斯的朝芽镇训练师
莎莉娜,\p梦想是成为表演女王,
现在正在丰缘地区旅行…..\p门后貌似有漂亮的精灵,
 想获得就得先打到我!
莎莉娜:你的精灵战斗很华丽啊！

t: N: Your forcing a battle on me was\na surprise, but I never expected\lsuch strength…!
was: N:你的强行挑战还真是令我意外,\n但没想到却有着如此的实力...!

t: ……It's over. The world is still\nbeing tainted by shortsighted\lhumans…\pand what hope remains is still\nbeing fought over in the ugliest\lway……
was: ......结束了\n世界被目光短浅的人类\p污染着那残存的希望,\n依旧被丑恶地争夺着......

t: I hold the power of myth itself,\nand still you pushed me this far…\pVery well, I acknowledge you. So\nthis is what a fruitless dream\llooks like…
was: 我拥有了神话的力量,\n竟然还能我逼迫到了这种程度,\p这件事就认可你吧,\n这就是没有结果的梦想吗

t: What?! I, Maxie, was caught off\nguard?!
was: 什么?!我,赤焰松,\n居然被打了个措手不及?

t: Then what was the meaning of all\nthis?!
was: 我这到底究竟有什么意义!?
好厉害呀{F9D3}!\n原来你是丰缘冠军呀{F9D3}!

t: Phew… That was way too intense… I\nhadn't even gotten fired up yet,\land… I lost?
was: 呋...这也热血过头了吧...\n我都还没燃起斗志就...输了?

t: You're about as strong as I am…?\nYou're not me from another world,\lare you…?\pHeh heh, I mean… even your battle\nstyle is just like mine…
was: 实力竟然和我差不多...?\n你该不会是另一个世界的我吧...?\p嘿嘿那个...\n战斗风格都和我好像哟...

t: You beat me?! How disrespectful to\nyour big sis!
was: 竟然打败姐了?你这是对姐的不敬!

t: I never knew Hoenn's Trainers were\nall so strong!
was: 没想到丰缘的训练家实力都那么厉害!

t: The power of you and your Pokémon…\nIt's beyond anything I imagined…!
was: 你与你的宝可梦的力量...\n超乎我的想象...!
我...和暗黑酋雷姆...\n竟然输了?

t: …Heh. My Pokémon are strong,\naren't they? …Though to be honest,\pthat might have been my limit just\nnow…
was: ……嘿 我的宝可梦很强吧!\n……不过要说的话,\p刚刚这个可能就是我的极限了……

t: What a dazzling show{0xF9 0xD3} What a\nperfect rhythm{0xF9 0xD3} No problem{0xF9 0xD3}!
was: 好华丽的演出{F9D3}\n好完美的节奏{F9D3}没问题{F9D3}！

t: How… can this be…?! I, the king of\nthe gods… have lost…?!
was: 怎么...可能...?!\n 身为神之王的我... 竟然输了...?!

t: How can this be! I will never bow\nto fate!\pCan the future really not be\nchanged…!
was: 怎么会啊！\n我是不会向命运低头的! \p未来就无法改变吗...!

t: You clearly don't get it. I was\ngoing easy on you just now!
was: 我看你是完全不懂,\n我刚才对你手下留情了!

t: Heh heh, how rude to your big\nsister{0xF9 0xD3}!
was: 呵呵,对姐姐竟然那么不客气{F9D3}!

t: Excellent! That's the strength I\nwas hoping for…!
was: 茬好!\n有着这实力才是我期待的...!

t: Hmph… I never expected such\nstrength. It's been a long time\lsince I battled in earnest.\pI lost fair and square…
was: 哼... 没想到能有如此的实力,\n好久没认真的对战一场了,\p真是输的心服口服...

t: ……That's you, all right. So this\nis your true strength……
was: ... ...  真不愧是你,\n这就是你真正的实力吗......

t: Chase: Yo-ho-ho! Super strong! You\nremind me of Trace in our deciding\lbattle in Kanto!
was: 小驱：哟吼吼！强大级了！\n让我想起在关东决战时的小进！

t: You barely passed. Keep working at\nit!
was: 勉勉强强及格吧,还得加油啊!

t: Looks like you've hit your limit.\nLet's stop here{0xF9 0xD3}
was: 看来你到极限了,到此为止吧{F9D3}

t: Blue: Just as I thought! No wonder\nyou became Champion…
was: 青绿:和我想的一样!\n难怪你成为了冠军……

t: Alder: Well done! You truly are\nwithout equal!
was: 阿戴克:干的漂亮!\n你才是真正的天下无双!

t: Diantha: The sight of a Trainer\nand Pokémon with such noble\lspirits…\pmakes my heart tremble!
was: 卡露妮:拥有高尚灵魂的训练家\n和宝可梦的身姿,\p让我的心激烈地震颤!

t: H-how can this be! My Pokémon,\ntempered through endless\ltraining!!
was: 怎,怎么可能!\n我千锤百炼的宝可梦!!

t: I lost… because you were simply\ntoo strong!
was: 是我输了……那是因为\n你实在太强大了!

t: Amazing! Just what I'd expect from\nthe Champion I admire{0xF9 0xE7}
was: 好厉害啊,不愧是\n我尊敬的冠军大人呢{F9E7}

t: Your feelings and your Pokémon's\nhearts caught fire in that one\lbattle! What a splendid match!
was: 你的情绪,宝可梦的心意,\n仅仅通过刚才的战斗就燃烧起来了!\l真是非常精彩的对决!
哦豁来了个不得了的挑战者啊

t: Oh, you've made it this far! Have\nyou decided which door to pick?
was: 呀都走到这里啦\n决定好选哪扇门了嘛?

t: Oh? Ah!! You've passed the trial!!
was: 哦?啊!!\n你成功通过了试炼!!

t: Rosa: Our performances really\nresonated{0xF9 0xD3} Thanks, stranger{0xF9 0xD3}
was: 鸣依：我们的表演产生共鸣了呢{F9D3}\n谢谢你啦陌生人{F9D3}

t: {0xFD 0x06}: That's our teamwork for\nyou{0xF9 0xD3}! The performance went great!
was: {FD06}：不愧是我们之间的默契{F9D3}！\n表演很顺利！

t: Wenyue: You want to battle us?\pNot without two Pokémon, you\ncan't. We'd be far too strong for\lyou!
was: 闻月：你想与我们战斗？\p如果没有两只宝可梦的话，就一定不可以的。\l对你来说我们太强了！

t: Ah, I just can't connect with my\nPokémon.
was: 啊，我没办法和\n宝可梦connect呢。

t: Want to battle? After this I'm\nheading up the mountain to hunt\lwith my friends!
was: 要来战斗吗？\n和你打完后还要和朋友\l一起去上山打猎呢！

t: Shion: You have to bring two\nPokémon before we'll battle you!\pJo'on: Because beating you means\ndouble the payout!
was: 紫苑：你必须要携带两只\n宝可梦我们才和你对战！\p女苑：因为战胜你的话\n也就意味着双倍的赔偿！

t: Every holiday makes me miss my\nfamily twice as much. A wanderer\lwho misses home should go back.
was: 每逢佳节倍思亲，\n游子思亲当回乡。

t: Hoh?\pORA ORA ORA ORA ORA ORA ORA ORA\nORA ORA!
was: 嗬？\n\p欧拉欧拉欧拉欧拉欧拉\n欧拉欧拉欧拉欧拉欧拉

t: Heiye: Want to join us? Baigu: Not\nwithout two Pokémon, you can't!
was: 黑椰:要加入我们？\n白菇：不准备两只宝可梦怎么行？

t: Aaaaaah!!! What have you doooone?\nM-my… my Right Hand of the King!\lAaaah!!!
was: 啊啊啊啊啊啊!!!\n你都干了些什么啊啊啊,\l我...我...我的王之右手啊啊啊!!!

t: I came to the lake to play with my\nbig sister!
was: 我和姐姐一起来湖边玩!

t: …What's with that look? I really\nam a mage! It's not a phase!
was: ……你这是什么表情?\n我真的是魔导师!才不是中二!

t: My fish got away because of you!\nMy bad mood just got even worse.
was: 都是因为你,我的鱼跑掉了,\n本来糟糕的心情现在更是雪上加霜
呜哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!\nFantastic!!!

t: Tch… You're far stronger than the\nlocals around here.
was: 切……你比附近的住民强得多啊

t: D-d-darn it…! Is the power of the\nMark of Courage not enough…!
was: 可...可....可恶...! \n勇气之印的力量不够吗...!

t: I haven't eaten anything in five\nwhole minutes! Come on, eat it all\lup, no leftovers!
was: 我已经5分钟没吃过东西了!\n来,全都吃完不准剩下!

t: Have the times changed? Or have we\nstill not mastered the ancient\lpower?
was: 是时代变了吗,\n还是我们仍未能掌控远古的力量?

t: ……Fine. You can have the Caterpie.\nJust this once.
was: .......好吧,\n绿毛虫就让给你了,就这一次

t: Orga: I'm the head of the Eterna\nForest Rangers, though for some\lreason those girls have taken to\lcalling us the Hero Club.\pOh well. Rather than fret over\nthat, how about a Pokémon battle?
was: 奥尔加:我是百代森林护林团团长,\n虽然不知道为啥在那群女孩子的口中\l就莫名其妙变成了什么勇者部.\p算了,比起纠结这些,\n何不来一场宝可梦对战呢?

t: Ah Jie: I'm Ah Jie. I hang out\nhere a lot. Let me see how tough\lyour Pokémon are!
was: 阿杰:我叫阿杰,我常常来这里玩,\n让我康康你的宝可梦是不是很勇
哼,哼,啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊(战术停顿),\n啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊\l啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!!!

t: So you've grasped the “Moment of\nIntent” too… Reaching that level\lis no small feat.
was: 你也领会了“意起之时”吗... \n能抵达这个境界实在不容小觋

t: Ohhh yeeeeah{0xF9 0xD3} Now kneel before me!
was: 哦噫噫噫噫{F9D3}来,给我跪下!
啊啊啊啊啊!我被你打伤了啊啊啊啊!

t: Do you know Lucario? A legendary\ncreature with deep ties to it\ldwells here…\pThe pinnacle of the Steel and\nFighting types… We're lucky enough\lto challenge it here…!
was: 你知道路卡力欧吗,\n这里栖息着和它有着渊源的传说生物... \p钢系与格斗系的顶点...\n我们在这里能有幸和它挑战...!

t: Anyway, you win… I have no choice\nbut to let you pass…
was: 总之是你的胜利...只能让你前进了....

t: I've finally made it this far…\nMom, Dad, wait for me!
was: 终于走到这里了……\n爸爸妈妈,等着我!

t: Hoshizora: If you only have one\nPokémon, we can't battle you.\pThat would just be bullying.
was: 星空:如果你只有一只宝可梦,\n那我们不能跟你战斗,\p那样太欺负人了.

t: Jiannanchun: If you only have one\nPokémon, we can't battle you.\pThat would just be bullying.
was: 剑南春:如果你只有一只宝可梦,\n那我们不能跟你战斗,\p那样太欺负人了.

t: Waji: Oh, not bad, not bad. That\nkid from Petalburg Woods has grown\lthis much.
was: 瓦吉:嗬不错不错,那个\n橙华森林的少年也成长到这种地步了呢

t: May: Ah, that really was an\nintense match.
was: 小遥：啊，果然是一场激烈的比试呢。

t: You're not only kind to Pokémon,\nyou're dependable in battle too!\lHow can you be so gentle and so\lstrong…
was: 你不仅是对宝可梦很温柔，\n在战斗上也很可靠呢！\l为什么你能够温柔又强大呢……

t: You're not only kind to Pokémon,\nyou're dependable in battle too!\lHow can you be so gentle and so\lstrong…
was: 你不仅是对宝可梦很温柔，\n在战斗上也很可靠呢！\l为什么你能够温柔又强大呢……

t: Watching you all fight together, I\ncan't help feeling “Now that's\lwhat partners are.”
was: 当我看着你们共同战斗的时候，\n会不由自主地感觉到“这样才是搭档”呢

t: …You remind me of that Red guy.
You're just as strong as they\nsaid… Would you consider becoming\lmy Pokémon{0xF9 0xD3}
was: 果然和他们说的一样强大呀……\n要不要考虑一下来做我的宝可梦呢{F9D3}

t: The teamwork between you and your\nPokémon is perfect. You really are\lgood at making friends with\lPokémon!
was: 你和你的宝可梦之间的配合真是完美，\n果然你很擅长跟宝可梦当朋友啊！

t: …Hmph. I lost, just as I expected.\nBut this time it didn't feel so\lbad.
was: ……哼，意料之内地输了啊。\n但这次的感觉还不错。

t: I hope Trainers like you will keep\nshowing everyone how people and\lPokémon should live together.\pHow to build a true bond, not a\ntwisted, warped relationship.
was: 希望像你这样的训练师，\n能多多示范给大家看，\l人类和宝可梦该怎么正确相处。\p如何建立真正的牵绊，\n而不是扭曲变形的关系。

t: Mm… I'm sure you can become as\nstrong as Gold and Red! I promise!
was: 哞……你一定能够变得跟阿金、\n跟赤红一样强！我向你保证！

t: Even without Musharna clearing my\nhead for me, I can come up with\lall kinds of tactics in a flash.\lThis must be the thrill of\lsparring with a rival!
was: 即使不依靠梦蚀帮我清空大脑，\n我也能飞快地想出各种战术。\l可能这就是和劲敌切磋的畅快感吧！

t: Every time I see you get stronger,\nI feel I have to try harder too!\pYou make people feel “I can't\nlose.” You really are amazing!
was: 每当看到你变得更强，\n我就会觉得自己也要加油！\p能让人有种“不能输”的心情，\n你真的很神奇啊！

t: I can feel it: the love for\nPokémon pouring out of your whole\lbody!
was: 我感觉到了，\n从你全身涌出的对宝可梦的爱！

t: To think you'd break my combo with\na strategy like that… I see.\lImpressive!
was: 居然用这种战术击破我的组合……\n原来如此，真厉害啊！

t: With your skill, you might rule\nthe Battle Subway in Unova!
was: 以你的实力，在合众也许能\n称霸对战地铁呢！

t: Uwaaah! Your attacks hit harder\nthan a steel Tyranitar!
was: 呜哇哇哇！\n你的攻击比钢铁班基拉斯还猛烈啊！

t: I lost… You're just too strong!\nBut I'll keep getting stronger\ltoo!
was: 输了……你实在是太强了！\n但我也会不断地变强！

t: As expected of the ultimate\nTrainer, {0xFD 0x01}. Your power\lsurpasses even the Ultra Beasts!
was: 不愧是究极训练师{FD01}，\n你的力量甚至超越了究极异兽！

t: The power of the bond between\npeople and Pokémon, each side\lclashing with everything they\lhave… Battling you was so much\lfun!
was: 人与宝可梦之间牵绊的力量、\n彼此的全力之间的碰撞，\l和你对战真是太开心了！

t: So this is your full power… You're\nstrong…
was: 这就是你的全力吗……真强啊……

t: If you took on the island\nchallenge too, the captains\lwouldn't stand a chance against\lyou!
was: 如果你也去参加诸岛巡礼的话，\n队长们一定都不是你的对手呀！

t: I can tell from how you battle\nwhat kind of journey you've had.\lHmph… I can't lose either…
was: 从战斗方式就能看出来，\n你这一路走来经历了什么样的旅程。\l哼……我也不能输……

t: I lost, but it feels great! So\nthis is what battling is…
was: 虽然输了，但是心里很舒畅！\n这就是对战吗……
最后一击的样子，真是太华丽了！
比冠军丹帝还强大的实力……

t: Maybe I'm better suited to\ncheering people on than battling?\l…Just kidding{0xF9 0xD3}
was: 也许比起宝可梦对战，\n我更适合给人加油呐喊？\l……开玩笑的啦{F9D3}

t: A battle style that's strong, yet\nstill gentle… I think I'm starting\lto understand what the Professor\lmeant…
was: 强大而不失温柔的战斗风格……\n我好像有点明白博士的话了……

t: Your tactics are meticulous and\nefficient, yet you battle with\lsuch flair. Who on earth are you?
was: 你的战术十分缏密高效，\n战斗起来却十分华丽，\l你究竟是什么人？

t: Looks like I'll need a stronger\nstrategy next time!
was: 看来下次要想出更强的战术呀！

t: Diantha: What a gorgeous,\nbrilliant battle that was…
was: 卡露妮：真是华丽而精彩的战斗啊…

t: Iris: Amazing… So this is the\nstrength of Hoenn's Champion…
was: 艾莉丝：太厉害了……\n这就是丰缘地区冠军的实力吗……

t: Mm…! It's frustrating, but you\nreally do know how to lead Pokémon\lin battle!
was: 哞……！虽然很不甘心，\n但你在指挥宝可梦战斗上确实有一套！

t: Steven: I knew it. I wasn't wrong\nabout you. You truly are a\lremarkable Pokémon Trainer!
was: 大吾：果然，我没有看走眼，\n你真的是一位很了不起宝可梦训练师！

t: Alder: Impressive! In any age,\nit's those who earnestly chase\ltheir dreams who change the world.\lThat's right! People just like\lyou!!
was: 阿戴克：很厉害嘛！不管什么时候，\n改变世界的都是认真追求梦想的人，\l没错！就像你一样！！

t: I could feel the bond between you\nand your Pokémon!
was: 你和宝可梦的詈绊，我感受到了！

t: Lingkong Yulu: Good, keep it up!
Cogita: Heh… I'd expect nothing\nless of you…
Akari: That last move was really\nbeautiful!
was: 小照：刚才的那一招\n可真漂亮呀！

t: Adaman: Looks like there's one\nmore name, besides Irida's, on the\llist of people I can't go easy on.
was: 刚石：看来以后除了珠贝以外，\n不能放水的名单上又要多一个名字了呀

t: See? There really were only two\nSteel types!
was: 看吧，明明就只有两个钢系！

t: Welcome to Café Cabin{0xF9 0xD3} Would you\nlike some Moomoo Milk?
was: 欢迎来到 山后屋咖啡厅{F9D3}\n请问要来点咩咩鲜奶吗?

t: Gengyi here beside me taught me so\nmany scripting tricks.\p
was: 边上的绠衣酱真是教导了我\n很多脚本方面的技巧呢.\p
